semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers A,B with A >= B >= 0, when d equals 0: Q_{A,B,0}(q) equals 1, the weighted polynomial ring S specializes to the rationals Q, the empty sequence of elements of S is a homogeneous regular sequence, the quotient by that sequence is S itself, and the graded Hilbert series of S is 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers A,B with A >= B and B >= 0

variables.name: A
variables.role: parameter of the objects Q_{A,B,d}(q} and the weighted polynomial ring

variables.name: B
variables.role: parameter of the objects Q_{A,B,d}(q} and the weighted polynomial ring

variables.name: d
variables.role: specialization parameter fixed to 0 for the claim

variables.domain: commutative ring; in this case equal to the rationals
variables.name: S
variables.role: weighted polynomial ring specialized at d = 0

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are required; the sequence is explicitly the empty sequence

statement_nl: Let A,B be integers with A >= B >= 0. For d=0 one has Q_{A,B,0}(q)=1, the weighted polynomial ring is S=Q, and the empty sequence of elements of S is a homogeneous regular sequence. Its quotient is S itself, whose graded Hilbert series is 1.
